confounding_traps.note: Operator 2 is routed disproportionately large batches; batch size directly scales scrap/rework cost through per-unit defect economics.

Supplier 3 batches are disproportionately scheduled on tight, expedited cycle times; a tight planned cycle time directly raises downtime cost independent of this trap. (Not material_grade — that is MT05's own apparent feature, and a trap's apparent feature must carry zero baseline effect of its own, per HANDOFF-053.)
Proxy/mediator trap: night shift exists largely to absorb rush turnaround demand, so it correlates with rush_order, which directly raises cost — not a pure non-causal confound like MT01/MT02/MT04.
